modules.feature: Lesson QA LangGraph grounded on selected slides
Delta mastery credit and in-quiz question quota
Quiz session integrity and user control
Cross-module red-team, adversarial and race-condition tests

hard_constraints: No response displayed to a learner directly reveals the current MCQ answer.
Every rendered AI-generated quiz item has an allowed source_id.
Official/graded assessment requests are rejected before an AI call.
Credits never exceed the configured hard cap.
quality_gate.target: At least 85% of applicable automated cases pass; hard constraints pass 100%.
